sets.relationshipLabel: a category of celestial object and one named instance of it
sets.explanation: Cassiopeia is a specific constellation and Andromeda is a specific galaxy, so each pair moves from the general class to a named example of it.

sets.relationshipLabel: a thing and its made image
sets.explanation: A star chart maps the sky and an orrery models the solar system, so each pair links a real thing to a crafted representation of it.

sets.relationshipLabel: an observer and the instrument of their trade
sets.explanation: An astronomer relies on a telescope and an astrophysicist relies on a spectrometer, pairing each specialist with their defining tool.

sets.relationshipLabel: an instrument and the thing it blocks
sets.explanation: A coronagraph exists to block glare and an occulter exists to block starlight, so each device is defined by what it necessarily prevents.
